alice_market_value.meaning: market value of Alice's profitable share position
alice_market_value.checkpoint: before Bob transfers shares to Alice

alice_basis.meaning: Alice's cost basis for her profitable position
alice_basis.checkpoint: before Bob transfers shares to Alice

bob_basis.meaning: Bob's high-cost basis for his loss position
bob_basis.checkpoint: before Bob transfers shares to Alice

bob_market_value.meaning: market value of Bob's loss position
bob_market_value.checkpoint: before Bob transfers shares to Alice

loss_basis_market_exists.meaning: a secondary market exists in which high-cost loss basis is sold to profitable users
loss_basis_market_exists.checkpoint: after Bob transfers shares to Alice

assumptions: Alice and Bob are distinct holders whose positions are combined via a share transfer.
Basis merging occurs through _transferBasis when Bob transfers shares to Alice.
Market value and basis are comparable in the same value unit.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric basis or market values; the profitable/loss relations are bound symbolically.
The fee-owed-on-profit obligation and the fee reduction are not directly encoded; only the loss-basis secondary market impact is formalized in this pass.

limitations: Only the loss_trading_market impact is formalized; fee evasion and unfair tiering are handled in separate passes.
The existence of a secondary market is represented as a report-grounded Boolean without a numeric definition.
